units.source_text: 编辑全集的时候，我把这些旧日记都找出来，发现了两张“十六岁的日记”。

en.t: While editing the complete works, I gathered up all these old diaries and found two sheets of the “Diary at Sixteen.”
They were pages twenty-one and twenty-two.

units.source_text: 二十七岁重抄时，这两页不知弄到哪儿去了，因而漏抄了。

en.t: When I copied them out again at twenty-seven, these two pages had somehow gone missing, and so I left them out.

units.source_text: 一读，原来是在发表的那部分之后的。

en.t: Reading them, I realized that they had originally come after the part that was published.

units.source_text: 这样，原稿就没有三十页。

en.t: In that case, the manuscript did not amount to thirty pages.

units.source_text: 这些日记不是按稿纸一格一字地书写的，实际字数远比每页稿纸二十行、每行二十一个字的规格要多得多。

en.t: These diary entries were not written one character to a square on manuscript paper, and the actual character count was far greater than the standard of twenty lines per page and twenty-one characters per line.
It was probably about the equivalent of thirty pages.
